parent_source: MetaWeft 5b864c20173e098eabb579dee892a012b64428dd; ranking controls from auto_explore/memory_retrieval_01/experiments/paired_grader_control_v1/control_a.json. Working source, prompts and resolved settings are captured per run; no runtime exploration imports.
hypothesis: Separating candidate coverage from procedural usefulness ordering improves frozen-memory retrieval; downstream task success is not measured.
intended_differences: HNSW top 225, Max selects 20, then nonthinking Flash grades the shortlist. Identity query and combined representation remain fixed; compare with v1 base and separately selected exact_base.
memory_structure: Frozen flat memory bank with canonical IDs, when_to_use, content and prepared combined text-embedding-3-large 1024-dimensional vectors; preserve source references outside ranking prompts.
retrieval: HNSW top 225, Max selects 20, then nonthinking Flash grades the shortlist. Search/fusion depths remain independent of final k. Exact overrides retain finite depth. Listwise inputs below 20 bypass selection without a call; utility grading preserves input membership. See executable preset for explicit controls and policies.
adaptation: Disabled in retrieval-only evaluation; returned memories are not rewritten.
execution_context: Downstream task execution disabled. One retrieval query per evaluation example; query-boundary recovery only.
evidence_update: Disabled; prepared memories and embeddings are read-only.
feedback_access: Retrieval sees task and candidate when_to_use/content only. Local indices replace canonical IDs in ranking inputs. Positive labels, source evidence and evaluator outputs remain evaluator-only.
memory_lifetime: One frozen full bank per run; independent isolated index and outputs. No updates or cross-query learned state. Shared response store is allowed; no_cache default with explicit resolved cache policy recorded.
selection_rationale: Second distinct design family by best complete discovery recall@5: run115 0.792835; later paired downstream control mean 0.789720.

historical_evidence.qualification: Historical recall and tokens do not measure the new HNSW defaults; repeated category names are not independent evidence.
